Q:
Do you plan your novels or write by the seat of your pants?
A:
I outline in great detail. My novels have multiple subplots and dozens of characters. I couldn't coordinate all that without a map. How do you get where you want to go if you don't know where that is?

Techniques: Assonance

Assonance is a fairly simple technique that you can use to make your writing hit a bit harder, and stick a bit longer.

Simply put: assonance is when the sounds are similar in the middles of words in a sentence.
